_doc: AI difficulties (src/ai, docs/notes/ai-core.md). No difficulty cheats: they differ only in speed of thinking (thinkScale = × manager intervals, reactionDelay s, apm = commands per minute), macro (parallelBuilds, builders, buildOrder name in buildOrders.json, buildStepDelay s, harvesters, superNodeHarvesters, solars, loadoutQuality 0..1, partFactoriesUsed), army coordination (attack: firstWaveAt s, wave size minWave + waveGrowth × waves up to maxWave, strengthRatio vs known enemy, maxWait s, retreatRatio of the wave's start strength, gatherFraction; micro: focus fire, pulling back damaged robots below damagedHpRatio, field repair below repairBelow at the rally point) and defences (defense = plan name in defense.json). AI v2 (docs/notes/ai-v2.md): research = plan name in research.json; repair: bay (damaged robots below bayBelow HP share and, with armless, robots missing an arm drive into an assembly bay for repair / arm swap), field (HoverTrucks repair units below fieldBelow and buildings below buildingBelow near the base), trucks = HoverTrucks wanted on top of `builders` for repairs and salvage; squads: homeGuard = army share kept home during an attack, concurrentDefense = home units defend while the wave goes on (the wave is recalled only when they are too weak), artillery = artillery shells from range behind the wave, harass = small fast squad against enemy harvesters (startAt s, size, minArmy, cooldown s, retreatRatio); counter 0..1 = how strongly the army reacts to the seen enemy composition (armies.json counters). AI v3 (docs/notes/ai-v3.md): bays { rally = assembly bays get the army rally point, crewQueue = free crews wait in bay crew queues (joinBay), stance = the bay's spawn stance is the behaviour of the robot's role }; squads.helpAllies = home units help an ally whose base is attacked; squads.superNode = a squad holds the super node (startAt s, minArmy, size, cooldown s after it had to leave). AI v4 (docs/notes/ai-v4.md): econ { minHarvesters = trucks (owned + queued) the team needs before anything else, hold = below that no robots, parts, crews, extra vehicles or bay repairs (except while defending); the missing vehicle factory / a supply building on a full population is reserved even against high-priority spending }. AI v5: attack.scoutFirst = when no armed enemy was seen for intelFresh s a scout looks at the enemy base before a wave (the attack waits up to reconWait s and is decided again); attack.guessBase = with no enemy building known the wave goes to the most likely enemy start before the super node; with scoutFirst the first wave's maxWait counts from firstWaveAt (else from the start, so it left at firstWaveAt); estimate { growthPerMinute, maxGrowth = the biggest enemy army ever known grows by this share per minute while unseen (at most maxGrowth), defenseWeight = known armed enemy buildings count × this } – attack decisions use this estimate instead of the shrinking memory (no estimate = memory only, as before); production.mechInterval = s at least between two robots (easy). D3 (docs/notes/d3-ai-economy.md): power { coverage = expected use of the owned consumers = the measured demand, at least this share of their full use (production buildings at full work, towers); a new consumer counts fully; the planned plant + HQ income must cover that, gateSlack = energy/s a new consumer may stay uncovered before a power plant is built first, maxPlants = most power plants (above it consumers are built anyway), averageSeconds = smoothing of the measured flow, reactShare / stockShare = one more plant while measured demand > reactShare × measured income and the store < stockShare × cap, lowReactSeconds = low-energy streak that adds a plant at urgent priority, requestSeconds = how long a consumer's request for plants stays, defenseWaitSeconds = a tower / turret waits this long for power before it is built anyway, banks = energy banks (@storage) once bankAfterPlants plants stand and the store is above bankWhenFull × cap }; a lost HQ is rebuilt urgently once its ore is there (economy hold meanwhile). R3 (docs/notes/r3-air-ai.md): air { hangarAt = s from which the aircraft hangar (@aircraft) is wanted once its rules allow it (research tier), null = never; aircraft = most own aircraft, one per aircraftPerMechs crewed robots; antiAir: when enemy aircraft were seen (AI.air.forgetSeconds) – towers = anti-air towers (@antiAir) wanted, at most one per enemy aircraft seen at once; mechsPerAircraft × enemy aircraft = robots with an anti-air weapon wanted, at most maxMechs }; aircraft and anti-air robots are not started while the energy is short (Economy powerShort / low energy), anti-air towers wait for power plants like other defences; repair.makeArms = with armless: a robot with a missing / broken arm and no arm in stock gets one ordered at a part factory. E1 (docs/notes/e1-ai-air.md): air { hangarPriority = priority of the hangar wish (low|normal|high|urgent, default normal; high = its ore is reserved before research / parts), reserveFrom = s from which population is kept free for aircraft (default hangarAt; always once a hangar is owned), reserveAircraft = how many of the missing aircraft get their supply reserved at once (rolling), releaseAfter = s an aircraft may wait for population before queued crews / combat vehicles are cancelled (null = never), tierLead = from hangarAt − tierLead s research picks the cheapest research of the tier the hangar's requiresTier still lacks }; after the opening, the economy hold also stops new buildings except economy builds and defences; crews and combat vehicles never use the reserve (crews may while defending), robots are assembled only when a crew for them exists or fits, research waits during the economy hold. H5 (docs/notes/h5-ai-extractor.md): deepExtractor { max = most deep extractors (@deepMining, deepExtraction buildings), startAt = s from which they are wanted, minOre = ore that must stay above the extractor's own cost, minArmy = crewed robots owned first, priority = low|normal|high|urgent }; wanted one at a time after the opening, not in the economy hold, not while defending, only once the game's rules allow it (tier + research facility); placed like other buildings (ring search behind the HQ). A9-F4b (docs/notes/a9-f4b-ai.md, src/ai/managers/Tech.js): tech { enabled; superweapon = build / launch a superweapon and research its program (Normal+, match option on), superweaponPriority; maxWishes = tech building wishes per Economy think; advancedFacility { minProducers finished production buildings and minHarvesters trucks before the next research tier building (rules.research.tiers requiresStructures, e.g. DataRelay) is wanted, priority; a lost one after its tier was open is rebuilt urgently }; enhancers { startAt, minOre spare ore above the cost, priority, kinds = aura roles in order (attackAura at the rally point, buildAura / defenseAura at the production buildings, reconAura only against cloaking enemies), one of each }; imagingPoles { max, startAt, edgeDistance from the HQ (left, right, front, then deposits own trucks mine farther out), minOre, priority }; detectors { max detection towers in front of the HQ (frontDistance) then at the rally point, only when a cloak-capable enemy was seen or an enemy faction researches stealth rules, minOre, priority }; railGuns { max of the longest-range buildable tower when it outranges the defence plan tower, frontDistance in front of the HQ, spread rad between them, minOre, priority }; archeology { max, minOre, priority }; generator { replacePlants = a big power plant (highest income) instead of this many new small ones, also when the small one finds no room or maxPlants is reached }; launch { minValue of the target cluster, weights per known enemy hq / production building / other building / army strength, killsCrewsArmyFactor for crew-killing strikes, ownMargin = no own or allied building within radius + this, ownPenalty × own army strength in the circle, resendSeconds }; evacuate { margin around a strike circle, extra distance beyond it }; protect { repairBelow = HoverTrucks repair the HQ and tier / network buildings below this HP share (like other buildings below repair.buildingBelow) } }.
